Campaign ran July 11–15, 2027 (Mountain time) and is now ended and paused. Here's the recap.

**Setup**
- One campaign, two ad groups (A/B of your two approved posts), targeting US + Canada, iOS and Android only, $100/day total, LINK_CLICKS goal, no age restriction.
- Note: X has no pixel for larchmorrow.com, so optimization and reporting were on link clicks — trial starts in the app are not visible to X and aren't reflected in these numbers.

**What happened**
- Days 1–2 both posts ran ~$50/day. Post B ("summer calendar… breather," 2206463218284357170) beat Post A on clicks and engagement, so on July 13 I shifted budget to B ($70/$30), and on July 14 paused A entirely and gave B the full $100/day.

**Totals (Jul 11–15)**
- Spend: ~$491.56 of the $500 budget (A: $126.77 / B: $364.79)
- Impressions: 410,327 (A: 109,270 / B: 301,057)
- Link clicks: 243 (A: 59 / B: 184); ~$2.02 per click
- Post B also drew more likes (59 vs 18) and the only reply/retweet activity.

**Caveats**: These figures show delivery and click-through only. They can't tell you how many people started the 14-day trial — that requires your in-app reporting. Click volume and CTR (B: ~0.061%, A: ~0.054%) suggest B's playful tone resonated better, but any conclusion about trial starts should come from your own data. Also note clicks aren't conversions; some clickers won't have the iOS/Android app ready or will bounce before activating the trial.
